integrity: Proof and exact finite-field orbit enumeration provided; machine verification checks samples only; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Desarguesian planes and the Singer–Frobenius collineation subgroup; one-dimensional ordinary incidence graph quotient, no point-line dualities or ambient-dessin-curve quotients. Higher homotopy of other complexes and full collineation group are excluded. Unindexed equivalent work remains a risk.
title: Singer–Frobenius symmetry quotients and fixed graphs of finite projective planes
